messages:
andrea: Heads-up — I'm prepping caelum-6b for onboarding. Weights uploaded to gs://redwood-models/caelum/6b/v1. Need quick eyes on tokenizer quirks and the license gate before I open the serving PR.

oliver: Looking now. Can you paste the sha256 of the tarball so I can validate integrity?

andrea: sure — sha256: 3f7b9a2c8d5e9a1b2c4dff7b1b2a9c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9
command I used:```bash
gsutil cp gs://redwood-models/caelum/6b/v1/weights.tar.gz .
sha256sum weights.tar.gz
```

sam: Quick note on tokenizer: the checkpoint uses SentencePiece with legacy ids — unk=0, pad=1. Our serving pipeline assumes pad_token_id==0. That mismatch leads to off-by-one tokenization which breaks caching & embeddings.
Suggest either remapping pad->0 in the tokenizer config or adding a lightweight adapter in tokenization layer.

maria: CI config validator failed when I ran the serving-config lint:```
ERROR: vocab_size mismatch (model: 50260, config: 50261)
ERROR: pad_token_id out of range
```
Looks like tokenizer metadata didn't make it into the model card or config blob.

oliver: That vocab_size off-by-one often comes from a sentencepiece extra <pad> insertion. Sam, can you confirm the actual vocab file? If it's 50260 on disk but model header says 50261 we need to align. Also please paste the tokenizer.json or spm model.

sam: Tokenizer files: gs://redwood-models/caelum/6b/v1/tokenizer/{tokenizer.json,spiece.model}.spm: vocab_size=50260, but the model's tokenizer_config.json was generated with pad inserted. I'll generate a cleaned tokenizer.json and push.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: serving-config-lint FAILED (job id: 8452). See https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/8452.

andrea: Thanks. On licensing: model_card.pdf is attached in the source bucket. Legal flagged it as NC-Research-1.0 — research-only, attribution required. @legal-bot can you confirm whether that blocks hosted API?

legal-bot: Model card received. License summary: "NC-Research-1.0" — non-commercial research use only. Required attribution: "Caelum Team (2025)" in product docs and an included attribution file. Implication: Hosted public API = BLOCKED without exec/legal approval. Dedicated and Private deployments = allowed if customer signs attestation and we add usage restrictions. Marking thread: needs-legal-review.

kevin: Noted. For onboarding checklist, we should: 1) fix tokenizer pad id and vocab_size, 2) update tokenizer metadata in model card, 3) include attribution.txt in model bundle, 4) add license tag in model registry and surface on Console. I'll add items to the PR template.

oliver: Andrea — pinging you for the config PR review once sam pushes the cleaned tokenizer. Also remind to add this to the model meta:```json
{"license":"NC-Research-1.0","attribution":"Caelum Team (2025)","weights_path":"gs://redwood-models/caelum/6b/v1/weights.tar.gz","sha256":"3f7b9a2c8d5e9a1b2c4dff7b1b2a9c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9"}
```

andrea: Will do. Sam — once tokenizer.json is updated, can you also bump `pad_token_id` in serving-config.yml to `0` and set `vocab_size: 50260`? Then open PR against infra/models with the manifest and the attribution file.

sam: On it. I'll also add a small remap in tokenization util to tolerate pad id 1 and remap to 0 at runtime as a short-term mitigation:```python
def normalize_tokenizer(cfg):
    if cfg.get('pad_token_id') == 1:
        cfg['pad_token_id'] = 0
    return cfg
```
I'll call this out in a comment so we don't silently hide upstream issues.

andrea: Perfect. I'll create the infra/models PR and tag reviewers: @oliver @kevin. If legal confirms we can keep as Dedicated/Private only, we can proceed with onboarding but block Hosted API in the registry UI.

legal-bot: To clarify the hosted block flow: Add label `license:research-only` and `hosted_allowed:false` in model registry. Legal will review enterprise requests case-by-case.

oliver: I'll review the PR when it's up. Quick pointer: include the tokenizer checksum alongside weights to avoid future mismatch confusion.

kevin: Also add a short note in the model card about dataset sources (high level) to satisfy compliance. Don't need full dataset list here, just a statement and link to internal dataset-review ticket.

andrea: PR created: infra/models#3123 — includes tokenizer fix, serving-config update, attribution.txt, and license labels. Tagging reviewers now.

deploy-bot: PR infra/models#3123 CI: lint OK, unit-tests OK, serving-config-lint now PASS (job id: 8460).

oliver: Reviewing now. Small nit: can you add a unit test that asserts tokenizer.pad_token_id == 0 after normalize? saves future headaches.

sam: added test in the PR.

andrea: thanks everyone — moving to close this thread once oliver approves and legal-bot attaches final note. Will follow up on hosted API gating separately. :thumbsup:
